creator: @theorbitanimator
title: Husser vs Reactor (3D animated concept fight)
summary: A 61-second 3D animated concept fight by Orbit Animations (@theorbitanimator), posted 2026-10-16 (~39.9k likes, 420 comments at save). Caption: "What if husser and the reactor fought?" Two glowing humanoids fight in a rainy neon city street. On-screen rules: "Husser gets 2x faster every 2 seconds. Reactor reacts 100x faster than a human" and title card "every 2 s Husser gets 2x faster - Reactor sees the future". Named beats: RULES, SHOCKWAVES ("His misses crack the road and kill a streetlight"), LIGHT BALL ("At top speed Husser turns into pure light and strikes out of it"), SEEING ISN'T MOVING ("Reactor still reads every attack, but his body is only so fast"), TOO MANY FUTURES ("Husser arrives before the last prediction is over"), THE PERFECT DODGE ("Reactor sees it and moves first. It isn't enough."), TOO FAST TO ESCAPE ("Knowing the future doesn't make you faster"). Dialogue captions: REACTOR "I can see where you're going."; HUSSER "You can see the future. But you still have to live through it." and "Seeing it coming isn't the same as stopping it." Husser wins; Reactor ends up on the pavement. Original characters by the creator; no external resource is named, so the entry logs the animation itself and its creator. Sampled frames across the full video were visually inspected. The mp4 was delivered to Shotaro separately (not stored in this repo).
